A letter for you

Read this slowly.

ON YOUR SPECIAL DAY · WITH ALL MY HEART

Dear Seetha,

Today is your birthday, but honestly, I feel like I am the lucky one for getting to know a person like you.

I hope this new year of your life gives you the kind of happiness that stays, the kind of dreams that come true, and countless little moments that make you smile for no reason.

Keep being the beautiful, genuine and wonderfully you person that you are. And whenever life feels heavy, I hope you remember that there is someone out here wishing the very best for you.

Happy Birthday, Seetha. May your smile always have a reason.

With love, always ♡
